# Harbour Plan
The harbour now opens at six for the ferry crews.
A steel breakwater guards the northern basin.
Ferry tickets are sold online and at the gate.
The lighthouse keeper logs every arrival in a shared sheet.
# Garden Notes
Roses climb the south wall of the cottage.
A gravel path winds between the herb beds.
The old well still gives cold water in summer.
Bees from the village hives visit daily in July.
# Budget Sketch
The ferry subsidy covers two seasons of operation.
Paint for the kiosk is budgeted in spring.
A reserve fund guards against storm damage.
